evidence: The HfO2 ﬁlms were deposited at 275°C and the pressure was kept at 0.5 Torr. Hf /H20851N/H20849CH3/H20850/H20849C2H5/H20850/H208524 precursor was introduced to the reactor chamber for 20 s, and this was then purged for 30 s. Following this, an oxidant O 3 was introduced for 5 s and purged for 30 s.
